notes.title: MINE SURVIVAL CHALLENGE COMING
notes.content:
We are working on many future features that we know you will enjoy, and the first new game mode to set sail will be a single player challenge for keen captains to survive in a sea of relentlessly spawning mines!

You will need to trigger chain reactions of mines with precise shots, to clear large areas of the map, if you don't wish to be completely engulfed by the little spiked pests.


We look forward to showing you more very soon!
